segments.en: May we return unto thee : The morning Tefillah !

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ אֵין עוֹמְדִין לְהִתְפַּלֵּל אֶלָּא מִתּוֹךְ כּוֹבֶד רֹאשׁ. חֲסִידִים הָרִאשׁוֹנִים הָיוּ שׁוֹהִין שָׁעָה אַחַת, וּמִתְפַּלְּלִין, כְּדֵי שֶׁיְּכַוְּונוּ לִבָּם לַאֲבִיהֶם שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם. אֲפִילּוּ הַמֶּלֶךְ שׁוֹאֵל בִּשְׁלוֹמוֹ — לֹא יְשִׁיבֶנּוּ, וַאֲפִילּוּ נָחָשׁ כָּרוּךְ עַל עֲקֵבוֹ — לֹא יַפְסִיק.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One» may «only stand» and begin to pray «from» an approach of «gravity» and submission. There is a tradition that «the early» generations of «pious» men «would wait one hour,» in order to reach the solemn frame of mind appropriate for prayer, «and» then «pray, so that they would focus their hearts toward their Father in Heaven.» Standing in prayer is standing before God and, as such, «even» if «the king greets him, he should not respond to him; and even if a snake is wrapped on his heel, he should not interrupt» his prayer.

moves.summary: one stands to pray only from gravity
moves.about: the early pious would wait an hour before praying, to direct their hearts to their Father in Heaven
